# assignmentB2KodiakBear

<!-- badges: start -->
<!-- badges: end -->

## Overview

The goal of assignmentB2KodiakBear is to provide a function that assists users in counting missing values for all columns by group. Given a data frame `data` and a column `group`, `count_all_missing_by_group()` creates a new data frame with one row per level of `group`. The first column of the output data frame contains the levels of `group`, and the rest of the columns contain the number of missing values for all columns in `data` except `group`.

## Installation

You can install this package directly by calling `devtools::install_github("UBC-STAT545-F2026/assignmentB2KodiakBear")`

```{r}
devtools::install_github("UBC-STAT545-F2026/assignmentB2KodiakBear")
```

## Package Components
 - `R`: A folder that contains the function `count_all_missing_by_group()`, which is held in a R script file
 - `man`: A folder that contains any figures used in knit files and `count_all_missing_by_group.Rd`
 - `tests`: A folder that contains the `test that folder`, which contains four function tests for `count_all_missing_by_group()`. `tests` also contains the `testthat.R` file
 - `.Rbuildignore`: A file that tells R CMD Build which files to ignore
 - `.gitignore`: A file that tells git which files to ignore
 - `DESCRIPTION`: A file containing package metadata and dependencies
 - `LICENSE`: A file containing basic license information
 - `LICENSE.md`: A knit file containing license details
 - `NAMESPACE`: A file that defines the functions within this package
 - `README.Rmd`: An unknit version of this README file
 - `README.md`: A knit version of this README file
 - `assignmentB2KodiakBear.Rproj`: The R project file for this package, containing the R setting used when working on this package

## Examples

This example computes the number of missing values in the `airquality` dataset grouped by the `cyl` column.
```{r}
library(assignmentB2KodiakBear)
library(dplyr)
count_all_missing_by_group(airquality, Month)
```

This example has the same output as the last example, but shows off an alternative way of invoking the `count_all_missing_by_group()`: piping the dataset into the function.
```{r}
library(assignmentB2KodiakBear)
library(dplyr)
airquality |> count_all_missing_by_group(Month) 
```

The optional `.groups` argument allows us to keep the output grouped by the grouping column. See example below; notice how the output is a grouped tibble, rather than the ungrouped tibble output of the earlier examples.
```{r} 
library(assignmentB2KodiakBear)
library(dplyr)
count_all_missing_by_group(airquality, Month, .groups = "keep")
```
